openrouter.note: OpenRouter passes tool calls through when the selected model supports tools.

cloudflare.note: Cloudflare AI Gateway routes OpenAI-compatible requests; tool handling depends on target provider.

vercel.note: Tool calling uses the AI SDK provider/model contract and gateway routing options.

litellm.note: LiteLLM normalizes provider tool schemas behind its OpenAI-compatible API.

portkey.note: Portkey routes OpenAI-compatible tool payloads; provider support remains decisive.
